gold: Drug-induced blepharitis and ectropion associated with TNF-α inhibitors (infliximab and adalimumab)

selector.rationale: Bilateral scaly, thickened, and erythematous upper and lower eyelids with crusty plaques on the eyelid margins and resolution after treatment discontinuation support Blepharitis

rejected.label: Conjunctivitis
rejected.why: Diffuse conjunctival hyperemia is a symptom that can be associated with other conditions, including Blepharitis

Blepharitis and ectropion during TNF-α inhibitor treatment.
